title: Enhanced Catalytic Performance for CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol over N-doped Graphene Incorporated Cu-ZnO-Al2O3 Catalysts
extraction_notes: No SI catalyst-performance entries were reported. The SI provides catalyst preparation and evaluation-method conditions in the Experimental Section (SI page 4) but no measured CO2 conversion, methanol/CO/CH4 selectivity, methanol STY, or time-on-stream performance values. SI Figures S1-S3 are characterization data and are out of scope.
